claim: *From substrate to method.* Finite reasoning state creates the Representation Problem; probabilistic autonomous work creates the Enforcement Problem. Chapters 2 and 3 develop MAGE's corresponding answers: Modeling and Alignment.

topology.description: Two parallel trait→problem→method derivations; Modeling and Alignment are distinct activities.

required_terms: Probabilistic productive work Observable, interposable seams
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: Two parallel left-to-right derivations connect substrate traits to engineering problems and methods. Finite working state creates a representation problem answered by Modeling. Probabilistic productive work with observable, interposable seams creates an enforcement problem answered by Alignment. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
